query: Triage the MCR board — what needs attention this morning?
expected_behavior: Pulls the full candidate set with pagination (the board has 200+ non-Done items and --limit 200 silently truncates), then enriches with updated/duedate/parent from the full item view
Applies the triage lenses (new/unassigned, stale or blocked, missing priority or due date, ownership gaps) and groups output by Marketing Theme
Suggests who fits each item via the team->role map and batches confirmations through AskUserQuestion
Stays git-free and read-first: it proposes assignments/transitions and writes them to Jira only on confirmation
